as_told.title: Hal Puthoff on psychic communication via extended electrodynamics

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says the physicist Hal Puthoff has a model he calls extended electrodynamics, an expanded version of the physics of electricity and magnetism built on quantities called vector and scalar potentials. In a later episode Michels says Puthoff talked about it openly on Anna Brady-Estevez's podcast, mentioned work with Josephson junctions, which are tiny superconducting electronic devices, and also credited Lewis Darro and Larry Forsley. Michels raises it because he thinks it might help explain how alien intelligences could communicate.
